crop.note: Multi-candidate crop. Generates up to four candidates — canonical (reproject onto the fixed per-target WCS, folio targets only), coverage (largest rect with >=80% frame coverage), intersection (largest rect covered by all frames), and lir (coverage-mask largest inscribed rectangle, always available). Selection is canonical-preferred with a Claude override: if canonical clips the subject, falls back to the largest-area crop among coverage/intersection/lir. With no canonical candidate, prefers coverage -> intersection -> lir. coverage/intersection require the stacker's <stack>_coverage.fit map. Legacy single-rectangle crop remains as seti_astro.crop (method=auto/bright/pct).

method.description: auto: coverage-mask + largest inscribed rectangle. bright: legacy row/column brightness threshold. pct: fixed percentage.

aggressiveness.description: auto mode: how readily a border tile is rejected as low-coverage (noise multiple of interior + blank fraction).

pct.description: Used only when method=pct. Fraction to remove from each edge.

threshold_frac.description: auto mode: edge row/column mean must reach this fraction of centre mean to be included.

buffer_frac.description: auto mode: extra safety margin added beyond detected boundary.

claude_confirm.description: crop_multi: run a Claude vision check on the canonical candidate to decide whether it clips the subject (canonical-preferred override).

experiment_variants.description: Edge-artifact trim (preferred): stretched-luminance edge profile + noise trim removes ragged/black/grainy edge stacking artifacts while keeping the full target
Reproject onto the fixed per-target WCS (canonical framing, folio targets)
Largest rectangle with >=80% frame coverage (stacking-driven)
Largest rectangle covered by all frames (tightest stacking-driven crop)
Coverage mask + largest inscribed rectangle, balanced (recommended)
Coverage mask, aggressive — trims low-coverage borders harder
Coverage mask, conservative — keeps more, trims only clear borders
Fixed 5% from each edge — simple fallback

subframe_culling.note: Rank and reject poor sub-frames before stacking. SEP-based FWHM + eccentricity + star count scoring.

bottom_pct.description: Fraction of worst frames to exclude. 0.10 = drop bottom 10%.

min_stars.description: Minimum stars required; frames below this are always excluded.

experiment_variants.description: No culling — use all frames
Drop worst 5% of frames
Drop worst 10% (default)
Drop worst 20% (aggressive quality cut)

stacking.note: Calibration, registration, and integration of sub-frames into a single stacked FITS.

engine.description: siril: fast, clean, well-tested. imagemm: multi-frame deconvolution = more detail. pixinsight_wbpp: best-in-class but slowest.

experiment_variants.description: Siril 1.4.2 — fast, clean sigma-clipping stack
Image MM multi-frame deconvolution — more resolved detail
Image MM with more deconvolution iterations
PixInsight WBPP — noise-weighted integration, best SNR

remove_pedestal.note: Optional removal of a documented residual ADC/calibration pedestal. Disabled by default: the global minimum of a calibrated stack is not proof of an electronic pedestal and must not be subtracted merely to force one pixel to zero. Run only when capture/calibration provenance confirms the remaining offset; force_apply is the explicit override.

cosmetic_correction.note: Remove residual hot and cold pixels. Per-channel local median filter: pixels deviating > sigma * MAD from their local neighbourhood are replaced with the local median. sigma=5 is conservative — only true outliers (hot pixels, cosmic ray remnants, stacking misses). Fast scipy op, ~0.5s.

sigma.description: Threshold in MAD units. Lower = more aggressive. 5.0 catches hot/cold pixels without touching signal.

kernel_size.description: Size of local median kernel in pixels. Must be odd.

background_extraction.note: AI gradient and background removal. Apply before stretching on linear data.

correction.description: Subtraction for additive gradients (light pollution); Division for multiplicative (vignetting)

smoothing.description: Smoothness of background model. Higher = smoother, less aggressive.

experiment_variants.description: SASpro ADBE poly+RBF degree-2 (headless, fast)
SASpro ADBE poly+RBF degree-3 (more flexible for complex gradients)
SASpro ADBE polynomial only (no RBF, faster, gentler)
GraXpert AI subtraction mode
GraXpert AI division mode (for vignetting)
GraXpert subtraction on the public ML-tools GPU worker
GraXpert division on the public ML-tools GPU worker
PixInsight GradientCorrection (modern ABE/DBE replacement)
No gradient correction (baseline)

adbe.note: SASpro ADBE: polynomial + optional RBF background model. Fully headless Python. Alternative to GraXpert; handles complex gradients well.

use_rbf.description: RBF refinement after polynomial stage. Handles residuals.

color_calibration.note: Photometric colour calibration. Broadband default = PixInsight SPCC (Gaia DR3 catalog, Sony SeeStar S50 sensor profiles). LP/dual-band default = SSSC (set via spcc_lp_filter; SASpro solves the system response from Gaia-XP star spectra, the physically correct calibration where SPCC's broadband white reference is wrong). The SSSC broadband variant below is EXPERIMENT-ONLY: the 2026-06-21 validation (C3) showed it only fires on star-rich fields (>=20 XP matches: clusters yes, galaxies/nebulae fall back to SPCC) and merely ties SPCC's sky neutrality where it runs, so it is NOT the broadband default.

spcc_lp_filter.description: Set true if an LP filter was used during capture

experiment_variants.description: PixInsight SPCC — photometric calibration (Gaia DR3). Broadband default.
SASpro SSSC — spectrophotometric calibration; solves system response from Gaia-XP star spectra. Needs >=20 XP-matched stars (star-rich fields only); auto-falls back to SPCC otherwise.
SSSC with no background pre-equalization (background-equalization race baseline).
SSSC after masked (signal-preserving) background equalization — preview shows the sampled patch.
SSSC after unmasked (whole-frame) background equalization — preview shows the sampled patch.
PixInsight ColorCalibration — background-neutral white reference (no catalog).
No colour calibration (control).

deconvolution.note: AI or mathematical deconvolution to recover spatial detail blurred by seeing and optics. Apply on linear data before stretch. IMPORTANT: BXT is best-in-class for SeeStar data and is always the reference, so the standard-mode default is now bxt_deconvolve (full BlurXTerminator). cc_sharpen may look sharper on a linear preview but creates star ringing halos that become catastrophic after stretch and star removal; it remains the automatic fallback inside bxt_deconvolve when PixInsight is unavailable, and the explicit cc_sharpen variant below for comparison.

experiment_variants.description: RC-Astro BXT — AI PSF deconvolution, best-in-class

experiment_variants.description: Cosmic Clarity light sharpening
Cosmic Clarity moderate sharpening (default)
Cosmic Clarity non-stellar only (preserves stars)
Cosmic Clarity aggressive sharpening

denoise_linear.note: Cosmic Clarity AI noise reduction on linear data via CLI subprocess.

experiment_variants.description: Cosmic Clarity light denoising — preserves detail
Cosmic Clarity conservative — very gentle, maximum detail retention
Cosmic Clarity standard — balanced luma/color reduction
Cosmic Clarity moderate denoising (default)
Cosmic Clarity aggressive denoising — for very noisy data
Cosmic Clarity denoising on the public ML-tools GPU worker
PixInsight NoiseXTerminator (best-in-class, requires PI)
PixInsight NXT conservative — less aggressive, more detail retention
PixInsight NXT two-pass — run NXT twice at conservative settings

PixInsight NXT strong — amount=0.90, 2 iterations. Matches Henry's manual PI workflow for globulars (C 80 2026-05-24, final score 8.2/10). Full noise removal appropriate when upstream BXT has already sharpened and the outer halo needs clean sky between stars.

star_sharpen.note: BXT correct-only mode: fixes star shapes (roundness/elongation) without deblurring or sharpening background nebulosity. Applied after denoise_linear on dense star fields (globulars, open clusters) where denoise inflates FWHM. Uses BXT AI model with auto PSF; sharpen_stars=0, sharpen_nonstellar=0 — pure geometric star correction.

bxt_auto_psf.description: Auto-detect PSF. Recommended for SeeStar data.

experiment_variants.description: BXT correct-only — AI star roundness correction, no background sharpening. Default.
Cosmic Clarity Stellar-only sharpening — sharpens stars without touching background. Fallback if PI unavailable.
SyQon Parallax sharpening on the public ML-tools GPU worker

stretch.note: Histogram stretch to convert linear data to non-linear for visual display. This is the critical perceptual step.

experiment_variants.description: Statistical stretch — linked, sky-dark target 0.08 + curves boost. Sky bg should land ~0.06-0.08 after stretch.
Statistical stretch — slightly brighter (0.13) for dim targets or very dark skies
GHS stretch — better dynamic range, good for galaxies. Pivot near sky background level.
GHS tuned for galaxies — stronger core-to-arm range with sky-aligned pivot
PI-STF stretch targeting background at 0.07 — linked (single curve from luminance), preserves SPCC white balance. Best for galaxies.
PI-STF stretch targeting background at 0.09 — linked, slightly brighter for emission/reflection nebulae.

Statistical stretch for globular clusters: targetMedian=0.11, blackpoint_sigma=5.0, curves_boost=0.05. Matches Henry's manual PI workflow (statisticalstretch.js). Shadow clip at Med-7.4×MAD is ~6× more conservative than stf_nebula (1.25×MAD), preserving the faint outer halo. CONFIRMED GOOD: C 80 manual result 8.2/10 vs pipeline stf_nebula 6.2/10 (2026-05-24). NOTE: lowered 0.15→0.11 (2026-05-29) after M13 run showed sky_bg=0.148 (over-stretched) and core clipping at p9999=0.999 before curves; dense globulars need more headroom.
Veralux arcsinh — fully linked (color_grip=1.0 preserves SPCC calibration)
Veralux with max colour grip and slightly stronger stretch

Veralux arcsinh for globular clusters with auto-SP background detection. sp=0.0 triggers auto-measure of sky background from image corners; that value becomes the symmetry point so sky → 0. log_d=4.0 then maps faint halo stars (3× background) to ~0.45 and bright core stars to ~0.80 — dark sky, visible halo, unclipped core. target_bg=0.08 lifts the post-stretch sky to a near-black reference level.
PixInsight MultiscaleAdaptiveStretch — self-calibrating, best for preserving faint detail
Adaptive multi-tool stretch: profiles DR/star_frac → selects STF/veralux/GHS/stat → verify bg+midtone+clip → corrects with GHS boost or veralux re-stretch. target_bg=0.08, max 3 iterations.
Smart stretch targeting very dark sky (target_bg=0.05) — for targets with large faint halos where extra shadow depth is needed.

stretch_stat.note: SASpro statistical stretch. Good general-purpose starting point.

stretch_ghs.note: Generalised Hyperbolic Stretch. Better dynamic range; recommended for galaxies.

stretch_veralux.note: Veralux HyperMetric arcsinh with colour grip. Good for reflection nebulae and colour targets.

scnr.note: Selective Colour Noise Reduction — removes green channel cast (teal artifact from Seestar OSC). Apply after stretch.

mode.description: avg: average neutral protection (standard). max: maximum neutral protection (gentler).

experiment_variants.description: SCNR average mode 90% — standard Seestar teal removal
SCNR average mode 70% — gentle green cast reduction
SCNR maximum neutral protection — most conservative
No SCNR (baseline — for targets that are genuinely green)

background_neutralize.note: Conditional post-stretch background neutralisation. Skip when representative sky ratios remain neutral after successful background extraction, SPCC, and linked stretch. Run only when measured sky G/R or B/R differs from 1.0 by more than 0.10; force_apply remains the explicit override.

mode.description: offset: per-channel shift. scale: highlight-protecting scale/pivot correction.

experiment_variants.description: Background neutralize — per-channel offset/shift
Background neutralize — highlight-protecting scale/pivot
No background neutralization (baseline)

clahe.note: Contrast Limited Adaptive Histogram Equalisation — local contrast enhancement. Brings out fine structure.

noise_reduction.note: Second NoiseXTerminator pass on post-stretch data for residual noise. Distinct from denoise_linear: this deliberately runs after stretch, uses the remote RC-Astro GPU when enabled, and otherwise falls back to the local RC-Astro CLI.

nxt_detail.description: Recorded for parity with the NXT preset; the RC-Astro CLI does not currently expose an equivalent control.

experiment_variants.description: Cosmic Clarity nonlinear denoising on the public ML-tools GPU worker
SyQon Prism Mini denoiser — gentle strength (0.65), free weights
SyQon Prism Mini denoiser — standard strength (0.85), free weights

star_removal.note: Remove stars for nebula/galaxy processing (process starless, then recombine). Optional — skip for targets where stars are desired.

mode.description: unscreen: standard recombination mode. additive: alternative for bright star halos.

experiment_variants.description: SASpro DarkStar AI star removal (unscreen mode) — headless
SASpro DarkStar AI star removal (additive mode)
PixInsight StarXTerminator — best-in-class star removal
No star removal (keep stars)

curves.note: Parametric tone curve for final brightness/contrast/colour adjustment. Applied on the starless stretched image (before star recombination). Use conservative amounts — the image is already well-stretched and small adjustments are better than large ones. lift_shadows brightens the background which reduces contrast and almost always scores worse; avoid it here.

shape.description: s_mild: gentle contrast boost (default, most versatile). rolloff_highlights: protect bright nebula cores. AVOID lift_shadows — it brightens the already-dark background and consistently scores as no improvement on stretched nebulae.

amount.description: Start at 0.3 (conservative). Only go above 0.5 if the image clearly needs a strong contrast push.

experiment_variants.description: PI CurvesTransformation — compact globular (M13, M3, M5, M92): darkens sky from ~0.15→0.12, neutral halo midrange (0.35–0.50 zone untouched), strong shoulder starts at 0.62, cap 0.88. Prevents blown-out core on tight high-surface-brightness globulars.

color_sat.note: Boost colour saturation post-stretch. Applied after curves to lift the muted star colours from stat_stretch.

color_sat_boost.description: PI ColorSaturation HS delta — uniform hue boost. 0.25 = moderate lift. >0.4 risks garish stars.

hdr_compression.note: Wavelet HDR compression — preserves highlight detail while boosting faint structure. Good for galaxies and bright nebulae.

n_scales.description: Wavelet decomposition scales. More scales = affects broader structures.

mask_gamma.description: Luminance mask curve. >1 protects more highlights.

hdr_core_blend.note: Wavelet HDR compression blended in ONLY under a feathered bright-core luminance mask (typically 0.3–2.7% of frame). Recovers blown-core detail without dimming faint outer signal the way global HDR does. Threshold set per object type by the pipeline (0.72 nebula / 0.80 galaxy). Clip-gated upstream; never stats-vetoed.

threshold.description: Core mask onset on smoothed luminance. Higher = only the very brightest core is touched.

n_scales.description: Wavelet decomposition scales for the HDR layer.

mask_gamma.description: Internal HDR luminance mask curve. >1 protects more highlights.

feather.description: Gaussian feather of the core mask edge.

sky_green_rebalance.note: SPCC-safe SCNR substitute: caps green at max(R,B) inside an inverted feathered luminance mask, so only the sky background is neutralized — object signal colour and SPCC star colours pass through untouched, and a green tint can never be inverted into magenta. Self-gates on measured sky G/R (no-op when <= min_gr).

amount.description: Fraction of the sky green excess removed.

min_gr.description: Sky G/R below which the step passes through unchanged.

dark_enhance.note: Wavelet dark structure enhancement. Boosts faint shadow detail: IFN, dust lanes, outer galaxy arms. Apply after HDR compression.

boost_factor.description: Darkness boost multiplier. M51 calibration found 3.0-10.0 spans distinct treatments after adaptive scaling; start at 5.0 and increase only if faint structure is clearly missing.

remove_stars_linear.note: Split image into starless and stars-only FITS before stretching. Starless continues the main pipeline; stars are stretched separately and recombined with combine_stars_screen.

mode.description: unscreen: correct screen-blend inverse (recommended). additive: for images with additive star halos.

experiment_variants.description: DarkStar unscreen star removal on the public ML-tools GPU worker
Current local DarkStar split treatment

stretch_stars.note: Stretch the stars-only FITS using SASpro Star Stretch. Applied to the aux stars layer, not the main (starless) pipeline path.

stretch_factor.description: Star stretch amount — higher = brighter/larger stars. At runtime this is overridden by a data-driven auto-selection based on the star layer's p90 brightness (target: p90 star → 0.25 post-stretch, 'subtle — secondary to nebula'). The default 2.0 is used only if auto-detection fails.

saturation.description: Post-stretch colour saturation boost for stars.

scnr_amount.description: SCNR green removal strength — injected from the starless SCNR experiment winner at runtime.

gamma.description: Curves brightness adjustment. Values < 1.0 brighten midtones (e.g. 0.85 = mild boost matching user's typical curves step).

experiment_variants.description: SASpro star stretch — factor auto-selected from star layer data (target p90→0.25, typically 1.0–3.0). SCNR=0.9.

combine_stars_screen.note: Screen-blend recombination of stretched starless + stretched stars. Must follow remove_stars_linear + stretch + stretch_stars.

halo_suppression.note: Star halo reduction via SASpro HaloBGon. Reduces colour halos and bloat around bright stars. Start conservative — level 1 is usually sufficient. Dense star fields (Cygnus, Sagittarius) must use level 1 only; higher levels crush thousands of stars at once and produce artificial blue-dominant colour casts.

reduction_level.description: Halo reduction aggressiveness. 1=minimal (default, safe for all fields). 2=moderate. Never use 3+ — causes severe colour artefacts in dense star fields.

is_linear.description: Set true only if applying on linear data (unusual).

color_boost.note: Hue-selective saturation via HSV Gaussian kernels. Galaxy: boost blues (spiral arms 210–270°), dampen yellows. Nebula: boost Ha-red (0°/350°), OIII-cyan (190°), magenta blend zone (300°). NBN: warm gold/copper dust (35°) + amber bleed (18°) + teal OIII core (195°), auto-selected when narrowband_norm is forced. Applied post-background_neutralize.

experiment_variants.description: HOO bicolor from true XP-extracted channels (R=Ha, G=B=OIII), linked stretch preserves the real line ratio
Foraxx dynamic palette (R=Ha, B=OIII, G=w*Ha+(1-w)*OIII with w=O^(1-O)), linked stretch
Synthetic SHO / Hubble (R=0.8*Ha, G=Ha, B=OIII) — golden-olive Ha regions, blue OIII
HOO with per-channel statistical stretch — surfaces faint OIII aggressively; only sane on OIII-strong fields

nb_palette.note: Narrowband palette composite from the TRUE Ha/OIII channels written by the xp_channel_extract hook (Gaia-XP mixing-matrix NNLS unmixing of LP dual-band data; fit on the star-full post-background_extraction image, applied to the starless linear image at the stretch boundary). REPLACES the post-stretch starless working image; stars are re-screened by the existing tail machinery. No-ops (keeps current image) when xp channels are missing or dims mismatch. Aesthetic step — never score-gate palette choice. SCNR is skipped when this step is forced (it would clip the palette's G/teal). Alternative to the narrowband_norm approximation path — force one or the other, not both.

narrowband_norm.note: PI NarrowbandNormalization on the HOO palette. The vibrancy lever is o3Boost (OIII boost) — auto-scaled from Ha dominance (ha_dominance_ratio) via o3Boost=clamp(0.50+0.395·ratio, 1.25, 1.7): a more Ha-dominant target needs more OIII boost to surface its weak teal core. Manual overrides nbn_o3_soft(1.3)/nbn_o3_strong(1.7). The old method (MaximumStars/Equalize) was a silent no-op in PI 1.9.3 (normalizationMode doesn't exist). The in-JS HOO saturation restore is disabled (hoo_boost=0); the dedicated nbn color_boost preset is the sole saturation pass. SCNR is SKIPPED on the narrowband path so OIII (which lands across green+blue on SeeStar duo-band OSC) isn't stripped before NBN balances. Placed where scnr would run, before background_neutralize. Equalize LIFTS OIII to match Ha (SHO/gold-blue look) — for a natural Ha-red-dominant result use narrowband_hoo instead.

narrowband_hoo.note: HOO-preserving alternative to narrowband_norm (2026-07-08): Ha stays the DOMINANT red, OIII is a bounded blue/teal accent — the opposite intent to Equalize, which lifts OIII to match Ha. R=Ha, G=0.15·Ha+0.9·O, B=O with O=min(OIII, oiii_cap·Ha). The local cap guarantees Ha dominance and forces O→0 where there is no Ha, auto-killing the field-flood that a naive OIII surface produces on Ha-dominant fields. oiii_cap is the one knob (0.6 near-pure-red, 1.0 max teal while Ha-led); soft/strong variants. OIII source: run_dir/xp_oiii.fit (real Gaia-XP channels) preferred, RGB blue-cyan-excess proxy fallback. IMPORTANT: needs SPATIALLY-DISTINCT OIII to show teal — on HII regions where OIII co-locates with Ha (IC 1805) the overlap reads gray, not teal; best for planetary nebulae / Veil / OIII-rich bicolor targets. Force via force_hoo (mutually exclusive with narrowband_norm/nb_palette). SCNR skipped on this path like the other NB steps.

narrowband_composite.note: Combine mono Ha/OIII/SII FITS into RGB using SHO (R=SII G=Ha B=OIII) or Foraxx (R=Ha*0.76+OIII*0.24, G=OIII*0.85+Ha*0.15, B=OIII) palette. Source paths provided via job extra_params['narrowband'].

stretch_quality_targets._description: Pixel-level targets after final stretch. Sky bg = corner median. Used to anchor Claude's visual assessment to objective data.

galaxy.score_excellent: bg 0.05-0.07, p99 0.50-0.62, spiral/arm detail visible against a dark sky, no clipped cores — score 8-10
galaxy.score_good: bg 0.07-0.09, p99 0.45-0.70, minor clipping in very bright stars only — score 6-7
galaxy.score_poor: bg > 0.10 (muddy/brown sky) OR p99 > 0.75 (galaxy washed out / over-bright) OR p99 < 0.40 (flat/under-stretched) — score ≤ 4
galaxy.note: M51, M81, M101, Andromeda — sky-dominated. Henry prefers a DARKER galaxy with high contrast (preferred M51 p99≈0.56, sky bg≈0.06); the old 0.78-0.93 p99 floor over-brightened to his eye. Keep structure punchy but not washed; mute the sky into the bg band.

nebula.score_excellent: bg 0.06-0.09, emission regions 0.30-0.70, dark lanes clearly visible — score 8-10
nebula.score_good: bg 0.09-0.12, most emission detail visible — score 6-7
nebula.score_poor: bg > 0.13 OR dark lanes invisible OR widespread halos — score ≤ 4
nebula.note: IC1396, M42, Orion, Rosette — emission fills more of frame

star_cluster.score_excellent: black background, stars distinct points, no halos — score 8-10
star_cluster.score_poor: grey background OR halos OR merged faint stars — score ≤ 4
star_cluster.note: M45, M44, globulars — pure stellar field, dark bg important

supernova_remnant.note: M1 Crab, Veil — faint filamentary, needs dark bg to see threads

seestar_broadband.description: Full Seestar OSC broadband: crop → BGE → SPCC → deconvolution → denoise → star split → stretch starless → SCNR → BG neutralize → CLAHE → noise → curves → HDR → stretch stars → recombine → halo

seestar_fast.description: Quick pipeline: crop → BGE → stretch → SCNR.

seestar_galaxy.description: Galaxy optimised: crop → BGE → SPCC → deconvolution → denoise → star split → GHS stretch starless → SCNR → BG neutralize → CLAHE → curves → stretch stars → recombine → halo. HDR/dark-enhance are optional (added only when the adaptive plan finds a blown core), to avoid over-cooking low-dynamic-range galaxy disks.

seestar_nebula.description: Emission/reflection nebula: crop → BGE → SPCC → deconvolution → denoise → star split → stretch starless → SCNR → BG neutralize → CLAHE → noise → curves → stretch stars → recombine → halo

public_free_core.description: Public golden-verification profile: the measured nebula sequence pinned to free/headless tools only. No PixInsight, RC-Astro, Telegram, or aesthetic API is required.

linear_only.description: Linear-stage only: crop → BGE → deconvolution → denoise. No stretch. Use when stretching manually.

seestar_starless_stretch.description: Starless/star-split stretch workflow: remove stars before stretch, stretch starless and stars separately (SASpro Star Stretch), then screen-blend recombine. Best for galaxies and nebulae where star size/color needs independent control.

experiment_full.description: Full experiment pipeline — all steps with all variants, Claude picks best at each. Star split before stretch.

spcc_only.description: Single-step SPCC test: runs only the color_calibration experiment (SPCC vs CC vs none) on an existing stack.

seestar_globular.description: Globular cluster optimised: crop → GraXpert BGE (fallback ADBE) → SPCC → BXT → NXT → stat_globular stretch (targetMedian=0.11, shadow clip at Med-7.4×MAD) → globular_balanced curves (lift halo, roll off core highlights) → assess. CALIBRATED 2026-05-24 from Henry's manual C 80 PI workflow (curves-only 8.2/10). KEY FINDINGS: color_sat harms result (8.2→6.2, green cast) — REMOVED. globular_balanced curve replaces s_mild: lifts faint halo, rolls off bright core. GraXpert>ADBE for large globulars despite gradient metric increase (cluster halo effect). targetMedian lowered 0.15→0.11 (2026-05-29): M13 run sky_bg=0.148 was over-bright; dense cores need headroom for curves to roll off highlights.

quick_default.description: GraXpert AI → SPCC (LP filter auto-detected) → BXT → NXT → SxT star split → star stretch → STF starless (linked, preserves SPCC balance) → screen recombine → assess. No intermediate assessments.

seestar_narrowband.description: Full narrowband palette workflow: Ha/OIII/SII → SHO or Foraxx composite → full processing chain with NBN and nebula color boost.
